title: Projection after appending two coordinates
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a vector in $\mathbb{F}_2^m$, and let $a,b\in\mathbb{F}_2$. The linear projection from $\mathbb{F}_2^{m+2}$ onto its first $m$ coordinates sends the vector formed by appending $a,b$ to $x$.
